feeds.title: Nia Patten Looks
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Nia Patten. I am a forty-something mum of three, a dentist, and an aesthetician. This is my darling blog where I write about skincare, cosmetics, and techniques. My main career in life in dentistry. I also do noninvasive facial aesthetics. So I tend to look at beauty products with a scientific eye and really put products through their paces. Hopefully, I'll save you a few pounds or maybe find something that changes your life.

feeds.description: Diary of the Evans-Crittens is a personal family lifestyle blog. The Beauty section is your source to find articles on not only healthy but skincare, hair, nail, makeup, and more. We share our days out, crafts, food, style, theme nights, home, travel, toys, books, films, and our day-to-day life with you.
